Who We Are

At Eddie Pearson Roofing, we understand that your home is more than just a building—it’s where your life happens. That’s why we’re committed to providing top-quality residential roofing services that offer long-term protection, durability, and peace of mind. Whether you’re dealing with storm damage, an aging roof, or you’re starting a new construction project, our experienced team is ready to deliver reliable solutions tailored to your needs.

We specialize in full roof replacements, new roof installations, and roof repairs using premium materials backed by proven techniques. As one of the few GAF Master Elite certified contractors in Mississippi, we hold ourselves to the highest standards in the industry. This prestigious certification allows us to offer the Golden Pledge Warranty from GAF—one of the most comprehensive warranties available—covering both material defects and our workmanship for added confidence.

Our approach is built on honest communication, dependable service, and superior craftsmanship. From your first consultation to the final inspection, we treat your home as if it were our own, ensuring your new roof not only performs well but also enhances the appearance and value of your property.

Choosing the right roofing contractor can make all the difference in the quality, longevity, and protection of your roof. At Eddie Pearson Roofing, we combine trusted experience with industry-leading certifications to deliver results you can rely on for years to come.

Here’s why homeowners and business owners across Mississippi choose us:

  • New Roof Installation – Expert installation for new construction homes with precision and care.

  • Full Roof Replacement – Upgrade your home with a durable, long-lasting new roof tailored to your style and needs.

  • Roof Repairs – Fast, reliable repairs for leaks, missing shingles, storm damage, and more.

  • Roof Inspections – Professional assessments to identify issues early and prevent costly damage.
